I've integrated the Pixel Pup into the game! I added the sprite sheet to the rendering engine, attached the card art to its entry, and implemented the necessary unit tests.

The build and tests are currently running in the background. I'll provide the final confirmation once they finish.
The build has completed successfully without any new warnings.

I've generated the detailed integration report containing the exact modifications, scale/health-offset rationale, test results, and build results as requested. You can find it here:

[mc-0010-pixel-pup-integration-v001.md](file:///E:/Projetos/MonsterCrypt/Crypt-Royale/.orchestration/reports/mc-0010-pixel-pup-integration-v001.md)

### Summary of Changes:
- Linked `cardArt: '/assets/cards/pixel-pup-card_v001.webp'` to the Pixel Pup card object in `src/game/cards.js`.
- Configured and registered `pixel-pup` within `UNIT_SPRITES` in `src/game/render.js` utilizing a visual scale of `0.45` and a `healthOffset` of `46`. This ensures that the Pixel Pup fits the scale of other similar units while accurately positioning the health bar directly above its visual frame.
- Added comprehensive rendering/fallback behavior unit tests for Pixel Pup inside `src/game/render.test.js`.
- The modifications passed all `52` local unit tests and verified the production build.

The Pixel Pup unit sprite is now integrated cleanly and safely into the existing unit-sprite registry. No core files outside of `render.js`, `render.test.js`, and `cards.js` were modified! Let me know if you need any adjustments.
